_description: Cash + Traditional at RMD age — RMD pulls Trad normally; Cash funds discretionary spending. Verifies RMD-first ordering survives cash priority 0.
_rationale: $300k Traditional + $100k Cash. User is 75 (past RMD age 73). Trad RMD divisor at 75 = 24.6 → required RMD ≈ $300k / 24.6 ≈ $12,195. Spending $30k. Year 0 plan: Cash priority 0 pulls $30k (covers all spending). RMD still forces a $12.2k Trad pull (which becomes rmdExcess because it's beyond spending need that cash already covered). RMD excess gets deposited to first taxable account (auto-created via ensureReinvestmentAccount). Federal tax on $12.2k Trad ordinary income — small (~$0 because under std deduction for single). Verifies cash satisfies spending first; RMD still fires independently.
name: Cash With RMD
